item.title: Stories Where Confidence Grows Slowly (and That’s the Point)
item.description: What does it even mean to come of age? Find your voice? As much as we might all wish for it, it doesn’t happen on the first day of school! It’s a journey of inches and minutes, and that’s the journey the books for young readers below explore. From learning to advocate for yourself and others to discovering your passions, these tales will help young readers build confidence and tell their own stories.

item.title: Kids’ Books About Loss and Grief
item.description: Grief is so challenging, especially when you’re young. Losing a loved one, a beloved pet, or even a home is a life-altering experience that, unfortunately, many of us face for the first time in our earliest years. These wonderful and empathetic books are here to guide readers young and old through the process of grief, and remind them that they are never alone.
